questions.question: What do certain organisms convert solar energy into through photosynthesis?
questions.fact: Through photosynthesis certain organisms convert solar energy (sunlight) into chemical energy.
questions.explanation: The fact states organisms convert solar energy into chemical energy.

questions.question: How does a deer obtain energy?
questions.fact: A deer obtains energy by eating plants.
questions.explanation: The fact says a deer gets energy by eating plants.

questions.question: How are the majority of carbohydrate molecules produced?
questions.fact: The majority of carbohydrate molecules are produced by photosynthesis.
questions.explanation: The fact states the majority of carbohydrate molecules are produced by photosynthesis.

questions.question: What does all food eaten by humans link back to?
questions.fact: All food eaten by humans links back to autotrophs that carry out photosynthesis.
questions.explanation: All human food links back to autotrophs that carry out photosynthesis.

questions.question: What continuously enters Earth’s ecosystems?
questions.fact: Energy harnessed from photosynthesis continuously enters Earth’s ecosystems.
questions.explanation: Energy harnessed from photosynthesis continuously enters Earth's ecosystems.

questions.question: Where did the energy in the plant come from?
questions.fact: The energy in the plant came from photosynthesis.
questions.explanation: The fact states the energy in the plant came from photosynthesis.

questions.question: Where is the chemical energy that each cell runs on mainly found?
questions.fact: Each cell runs on the chemical energy found mainly in carbohydrate molecules (food).
questions.explanation: Each cell runs on chemical energy found mainly in carbohydrate molecules (food).

questions.question: What do oceanic algae contribute to global food chains?
questions.fact: Oceanic algae contribute enormous quantities of food to global food chains.
questions.explanation: Oceanic algae contribute enormous quantities of food to global food chains.

questions.question: What is used to build carbohydrate molecules?
questions.fact: The chemical energy from photosynthesis is used to build carbohydrate molecules.
questions.explanation: The chemical energy from photosynthesis is used to build carbohydrate molecules.

questions.question: What are all animals?
questions.explanation: The fact states that all animals are heterotrophs.
